acceptance: exact independence in the stated strong-product cycle graph
strict improvement against up-to-date identified prior art before a new-bound claim

comparison_scope: Prospective algorithmic construction/execution comparisons only. No controlled frontier-model discovery comparison or billed API experiment is available.

authoring_telemetry: Same-session GPT-6 Astra reasoning/team/tool use is live authoring. Model token/billing totals unavailable; it is not measured model-capability or Operational Alpha evidence.
confirmation_freeze: Freeze final requirements, code, comparator access and resource ceilings before generating fresh confirmation seeds. Disclose exploratory cases separately.
